searchedFor: glob packages/cli/test/** for a command/e2e-level suite
findings.summary: The `output` "regression guard for #660" cannot fail on the regression it claims to guard
findings.evidence: packages/cli/test/output.test.ts:157-164 comments itself as "Regression guard for #660" and asserts `output({a:1},'json')` prints the body. But the actual regression this PR fixes lives at the ~30 call sites that used to pass `opts.quiet` (e.g. packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts:83, cells.ts:26). After the signature change, `output` unconditionally prints regardless of quiet, so the assertion holds trivially and would ALSO have held on the old code (which was called with quiet=false in this test's shape). If someone reintroduced suppression at a call site (`if (!opts.quiet) output(...)`) or re-added a defaulted `quiet` param, this test still passes. Nothing in packages/cli/test parses `--quiet` through a command action and asserts the body is still written to stdout — namespaces.test.ts:11 shows the createProgram()-based harness exists to do exactly that but only inspects option metadata. The comment's fallback claim ("a caller that tries to pass one fails to compile") is a type-level assertion never exercised by any test (no expectTypeError / ts-expect-error case).

findings.summary: Deleted quiet test for `outputError` replaced by an unrelated case; the new "errors print even under quiet" contract is untested
findings.evidence: The diff removes `it('honors quiet by exiting 1 without emitting stderr')` and substitutes `it('stringifies non-Error throwables')` (packages/cli/test/output.test.ts:137-141), which exercises the pre-existing `String(error)` branch, not the changed behavior. The new documented contract in packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts:44-51 — that the error envelope survives `--quiet` — has no test at any level: every remaining outputError test calls it directly with no quiet notion, and no command-level test runs a failing command with `--quiet` to assert stderr is non-empty and exitCode is 1. Net effect: a behavior change (quiet no longer silences errors) shipped with strictly less coverage of quiet than before.
